title: Chai's More Nuggets
description: Get more nuggets when smelting metal tools and armor
body:
# Chai's More Nuggets

When smelting metal tools and armor, it will return nuggets proportional to how many ingots were used to craft the item.

This is using the new `count` field in smelting and blasting recipes from 26.1 Snapshot 3. Due to how it currently works, make sure to remove nuggets from the output slot or it will only smelt 1 nugget at a time!
